release_notes: The HikMicro HM-TD1228-2 is a bi-spectrum turret camera fusing a 256x192 thermal module with a 5 MP optical channel, driven by the GUANLAN large-scale AI model for extended-range, low-false-alarm perimeter protection. It adds fire-point and smoking detection and temperature exception alarms (-20 to 150 C).

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80, Profile S/G). Thermal + optical exposed as separate channels.
